parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: AuthId
parameters.description: The ID of the authorization record.

parameters.name: GatewayUniqueId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the gateway.

parameters.name: IgnoreCase
parameters.description: Specifies whether the matching is not case-sensitive. Default value: true.

parameters.name: MatchType
parameters.description:
The matching type. Valid values:

*   EQUAL
*   PRE
*   ERGULAR
